name: DingTalk Auto-Pilot
description: Automatically clicks Accept if the classification is Valid. Adds Shift+↑ hotkey to apply Annotators-exclude filter. Breaks Shift+↑ bounce-back loop with Shift+↓ when the same task is seen 3+ times in 2 minutes. After Update, detects the 'Quality Check Failed' modal (.lsf-modal-dm) and dismisses it by clicking 'Ignore & Submit' before moving to the next task. Created by IQ.Automatron
